# Farclean

> > Farclean provides turnkey cleanroom solutions and contamination control systems for pharmaceutical, semiconductor, biotech, and electronics industries with GMP and ISO 14644 compliance.

Established in 2002, Farclean specializes in cleanroom design, construction, and equipment manufacturing including HEPA/ULPA filtration systems, FFU units, modular panels, air showers, and HVAC integration. The company serves global markets with expertise in GMP-compliant pharmaceutical facilities, ISO-certified semiconductor cleanrooms, and specialized laboratory environments.

## Key Topics

- ISO 14644 Standards
- GMP Compliance
- HEPA/ULPA Filtration
- FFU (Fan Filter Units)
- Contamination Control
- Turnkey Cleanroom Solutions
- HVAC Systems
- Modular Cleanroom Construction
- Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
- Semiconductor Cleanrooms
- ISO Class 7/8 Environments
- FDA Compliance
- IQ/OQ/PQ Validation
- Air Quality Testing
- Cleanroom Equipment
